caption: The drawing depicts a single armchair crafted in a classical style. The chair is colored with varying shades of brown, ranging from dark, nearly black areas to lighter, reddish-brown patches, giving the impression of polished or aged wood. The chair features substantial, solid arms; the right arm (from the viewer's perspective) is carved with a scroll pattern at the front and a lion's or animal's paw detail at the base. The left arm of the chair is rougher, more irregular, and less ornamented. The overall form of the chair is rounded, with a curved backrest that wraps around the seat. The chair is depicted within a rectangular outline, possibly to frame or emphasize the illustration. There is a signature, "Florence True Slosson," located beneath the left front leg of the chair. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored.
title: Walnut Chair
